name: Attention Restoration Theory
short_description: Theory explaining how natural environments replenish directed attention capacity through soft fascination.

components.name: Soft Fascination
components.description: Involuntary, effortless attention captured by inherently interesting but not overwhelming stimuli.

components.name: Being Away
components.description: Psychological distance from routine mental demands and fatiguing tasks.

components.name: Extent
components.description: The environment has sufficient scope and coherence to constitute an alternative world to explore.

components.name: Compatibility
components.description: The environment supports the individual's purposes and inclinations.
